_read_me: The Contact page's form (contact.html). One setting decides which wording it shows: mode.
mode "quote": "Request a quote". Imperion asked for it, November 12, 2026, while the new number went through texting approval (A2P).
mode "question": the form as it was before, "Got a question first?". Live since November 26, 2026 (Emmett).

consent: the two optional tick boxes (texts, offers) and the terms line. Standard on every mode (Emmett, November 26): the Contact form and the /book page always show them, and the booking form's own boxes say the same words.
Both wordings stay in this file. HTML is allowed in the text (links, ’). {phone} becomes the business number (config/business.json, or BUSINESS_PHONE in Netlify).
A mistake in this file fails the build.

consent.smsBox: I consent to receive SMS notifications, alerts & occasional marketing communication from 513 Auto Clean. Message frequency varies. Message & data rates may apply. Text HELP to {phone} for assistance. You can reply STOP to unsubscribe at any time.
consent.marketingBox: I want to receive news, feature updates, discounts & offers from 513 Auto Clean.
consent.termsLine: By continuing you agree to our Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy.
